// Generated by tools/ci/skill_supplies_test.py --emit.
// Direct skill-use materials, ammunition, runes/poisons and required tools.
// Not a skill unlocker or a complete crafting-recipe ingredient shop.
// Prices: database Buy, fallback 1000z; at least twice explicit Sell.
-	script	Skill Supplies	-1,{
	mes "[Skill Supplies]";
	mes "Supplies for every job's item-based skills.";
	mes "Skills must still be learned. Equipment, summons and other requirements still apply.";
	mes "Prices use normal item buy prices; unpriced items start at 1,000 Zeny.";
	next;
	switch(select("Skill materials:Ammunition:Runes and poisons:Skill tools:Cancel")) {
	case 1: close2; callshop "SS_Materials",1; end;
	case 2: close2; callshop "SS_Ammo",1; end;
	case 3: close2; callshop "SS_Runes",1; end;
	case 4: close2; callshop "SS_Tools",1; end;
	default: close;
	}
}
